items.label: REQUIRES TROOMI SERVICE PLAN
items.value: This Amazon purchase includes the phone only. Requires Troomi service plan (sold separately) to activate. Troomi service runs on the AT&T network.

items.label: ACTIVATION REQUIRED
items.value: Activation is completed during setup and connects the phone to your Troomi account and safety controls in the Parent Portal.

items.label: A SAFER FIRST SMARTPHONE FOR KIDS
items.value: Designed specifically for kids and teens, Troomi phones help families introduce technology gradually. Parents manage apps, contacts, screen time, and location through the Troomi Parent Portal for a safer first phone experience.

items.label: PARENT-APPROVED APPS ONLY
items.value: Kids cannot download apps freely from an open app store. Parents choose apps from the Troomi App Library. Some school or social apps may not be available, so we recommend checking your child’s required apps before purchasing.

items.label: SAFE CALLING & TEXTING
items.value: Kids can call and text with only parent-approved contacts. Parents can choose to automatically block unknown numbers. Parents receive alerts if concerning content appears in messages.

items.label: REAL-TIME GPS LOCATION TRACKING
items.value: Check your child’s location anytime and view location history directly in the Parent Portal so you can stay connected and informed.

items.label: SCREEN TIME MANAGEMENT MADE SIMPLE
items.value: Set daily screen limits, schedule phone-free times, and manage when apps can be used — all remotely through the Parent Portal.

items.label: START SAFE. ADD FREEDOM OVER TIME
items.value: Troomi grows with your child. As they mature, parents can allow additional apps and more flexible browsing options while keeping safety controls in place.

items.label: BUILT ON A TRUSTED SAMSUNG DEVICE
items.value: Powered by the Samsung Galaxy A16 and enhanced with Troomi’s child-safe operating system for a secure, reliable phone designed for young users.
